description: DEFERRED / independent of the read-only edge model. Allow editing aims in a linked repo when the user opts in via a per-linked-repo machine-local read/write toggle. backend writeAim already accepts any local .bowman path; sharing/pushing is plain git done by the user outside the app. Ship after read-only cross-repo links land so the foundational slice stays small.

status.comment: Cancelled 2026-09-20: editing aims inside a linked repo presumes those aims are surfaced at all. Under black-box repo links none are, so there is nothing to make writable. You edit another repo's graph by opening that repo.

reflection: Cancelled, not parked: presupposes the aim-level model Felix ruled out; the machine-local read/write access flag on the registry entry is the only remnant and already exists.
